cpu_binary64_identity_argument: Every saved scientific input is CPU binary64. Same dtype/device tensor conversions are identities; Python h stays the same binary64 value. No enclosure add, multiply, power or merge order changes.

The additional concat category is copied only when already present. In the frozen dense validator, endpoint is constructed after the last RHS composition and returned immediately. Its only flowpipe consumer reads its ledger for diagnostics. The next dense step is initialized from the sparse normal state with initial_remainder, not this endpoint ledger. Thus this new concat branch is absent from the frozen solve path.

All serialized endpoints are replayed from full segment coefficients with the delivery code and compared bit-for-bit. Independent Fraction checks separately establish coefficient and full-function inclusion; replay equality alone is not the mathematical proof.
